def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Identity_Theft_Reports_by_Type.csv', 
                      encoding='cp1252', header=0)
    df.columns = ['Theft Type', 'Theft Subtype', 'Number of Reports', 'Percent Difference']
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[~df['Theft Type'].isna()]
    df['Number of Reports'] = df['Number of Reports'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').str.strip()
    df = df[df['Number of Reports'].str.match(r'^\d+$', na=False)]
    df['Number of Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Number of Reports'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Number of Reports'])
    return df

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Type.csv', 
                      encoding='cp1252', header=1)
    df.columns = ['Report Type', 'Number of Reports', 'Percent of Total', 'col4', 'col5', 'col6']
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[~df['Report Type'].isna()]
    df['Number of Reports'] = df['Number of Reports'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').str.strip()
    df = df[df['Number of Reports'].str.match(r'^\d+$', na=False)]
    df['Number of Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Number of Reports'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Number of Reports'])
    return df[['Report Type', 'Number of Reports']]
